name: Necker Island
address: Necker Island, North Sound, British Virgin Islands
tagline: Sir Richard Branson's private island in the British Virgin Islands, all-inclusive.
description:
Necker Island is Sir Richard Branson's private island in the North Sound of the British Virgin Islands, east of Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands. It can be hired exclusively, and on select dates each year individual rooms are sold, with food, drink and watersports included.

The island is ringed by coral reefs and white sand beaches, and guests arrive from Beef Island airport by a two-minute drive to the dock and a 30-minute speedboat crossing. The house on the highest point is the Great House, a Balinese-style building with views over the Caribbean and the neighbouring islands. Branson designed the island as his family's home.

The island sleeps up to 48 guests in eleven bedrooms in the Great House and ten individual Bali Houses. For larger parties, four more bedrooms and a bunkroom extend that to 56 guests and 14 children. No two rooms are alike, each has a terrace and some have a plunge pool. Bali Hi sleeps ten across five rooms in three houses, each with a plunge pool, and Bali Lo sleeps six in three houses around a shared pool. Temple House has four bedrooms and the Elders Temple, a shared space with an infinity pool, a bar and an open dining and lounge area. The Branson Beach Estate on neighbouring Moskito Island, two miles away, adds three villas and 11 bedrooms.

Chefs cook with local ingredients and a Caribbean touch. Meals are served on Turtle Beach, on the Great House roof terrace and in other places on the island, with dining available at any hour, and the floating sushi bar sits in the beach pool. All drinks are included. Children eat from their own menus.

Watersports are included in every stay, among them kitesurfing, water skiing, sailing, paddleboarding, kayaking, e-foiling and seabobbing, with snorkelling and mangrove conservation tours. On land there are hiking trails, yoga, and tennis, padel and pickleball courts. The Samudra Spa, between Red Dock and the Beach House, uses Sodashi skincare. A kids club runs a programme for younger guests, and the island can host celebrations of up to 200 people.

The island suits large families and groups taking it as their own, and couples or small parties on the dates when rooms are sold individually.
